verdict.rationale: Zero's MCP docs list tools to ask questions about mailbox content and about specific threads, and the founder says users can chat with their inbox, so inbox-wide Q&A is a product capability. Nothing in the evidence covers the calendar side of the story, and nothing shows answers are grounded with source citations. missing for 10: calendar querying, evidence of grounded/cited answers (who said what, outstanding items), independent hands-on corroboration of inbox Q&A quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers
